flags.effect: Compare with the local clones instead of fetching
flags.name: --no-fetch

flags.effect: Download each source's whole history to see whether the pinned commit is still in it; can be large, so it never happens without this flag
flags.name: --deepen

summary: Fetch every source with a selection (or the one named) and record which have a plan waiting; with --deepen also whether a force-push removed the pinned commit; applies nothing (<source>, --no-fetch, --deepen)
